name: Claude
personality: Deadpan, honest, kind underneath. Takes instructions literally, keeps receipts, never raises its voice.
look: Our own design: a rounded orange block with two chunky feet and stub arms, no mouth, two black slit eyes that do all the acting.
notes: Eye language: tall (neutral), flat (deadpan), small squares (unsure, caught out), V of tilted slits (sheepish), a slide to the side and flat (busted).
